explanation: 'net satis tutari' → SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.TRCODE IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE.LINENET ELSE STLINE.LINENET END) [CERTIFIED]

prompt: Ocak 2022 için ürün bazında net satış tutarı göster.
sql:
SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-02-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC

  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-06-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-07-01'

  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-12-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-01-01'

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-07-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-08-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
